business: Pet Adventures Inc / Dusty Tails Lodge
headline: Google shows set opening hours and showed you Closed, while your site says you are by appointment only.
summary: Pet Adventures Inc, doing business as Dusty Tails Lodge, is Marlie and Justin's home-style dog boarding, playcare, and training on 9 acres at 283 Ramona Real in Ramona. Google Maps has a good card with the address, phone, website, photos, and an owner post from April. The leftover is about hours: Google lists opening hours and showed you Closed when we checked, with the next opening several days out, while your site asks people to call first and lists "Monday - Sunday" as "Appointments only."

signals.note: You show up on Google Maps as Pet Adventures Inc / Dusty Tails Lodge, Pet boarding service, 283 Ramona Real, Ramona, with sandiegodogcare.com, (760) 828-0961, photos, reviews, and a From the owner post dated Apr 23, 2026.
signals.next: Keep posting happy pups now and then. It shows the card is cared for.

signals.note: 760-828-0961 and info@sandiegodogcare.com are in the footer of every page and on the Contact page, and the phone matches Google. One phone and one inbox is exactly right.
signals.next: Keep the phone and inbox the same on every listing.

signals.note: The site says "Always call first to set up an appointment" and lists "Monday - Sunday" as "Appointments only." Google showed Closed when we checked, opening at 9 AM several days later.
signals.next: Mark Google as by appointment, or set hours that match how you book, so nobody skips you on a closed day.

signals.note: Google has photos on your card, and the site has a Photo Gallery page.
signals.next: Add a few fresh playcare shots to Google with your next post.

signals.note: The site explains how to become a client, the meet and greet, and the practice overnight, with booking online. The Available Animals page still says "New baby lops due March 31, 2026, check back for photos!"
signals.next: Swap in photos of the new lops or a current note.

signals.note: Address and phone match on the site and Google. Google names you Pet Adventures Inc / Dusty Tails Lodge. The site's page titles and footer say Pet Adventures Inc, the web address is sandiegodogcare.com, and Dusty Tails Lodge only appears in the About story.
signals.next: Pick the name you want people to remember and use it the same way on the site and Google.
